from csvparse import parse_csv

def test_parse_csv():
    test_cases = [
        # (input, delimiter, expected)
        ("", ",", []),
        ("a,b,c", ",", [["a", "b", "c"]]),
        ("a\nb\n", ",", [["a"], ["b"]]),
        ("a\r\nb\r\n", ",", [["a"], ["b"]]),
        ("a,b,c\r\n", ",", [["a", "b", "c"]]),
        ("a,,c", ",", [["a", "", "c"]]),
        ('a,"b,c",d', ",", [["a", "b,c", "d"]]),
        ('a,"b ""quoted"" c",d', ",", [["a", 'b "quoted" c', "d"]]),
        ('a,"b\nc",d', ",", [["a", "b\nc", "d"]]),
        ('"a","b"', ",", [["a", "b"]]),
        ('""', ",", [[""]]),
        ('"" ""', ",", [["", " "], [""]]), # This depends on how trailing spaces/quotes are handled
        ('a,b,c,', ",", [["a", "b", "c", ""]]),
        ('', ",", []),
    ]

    for i, (text, delim, expected) in enumerate(test_cases):
        try:
            result = parse_csv(text, delim)
            if result != expected:
                print(f"Test {i} failed: Input={repr(text)}, Expected={expected}, Got={result}")
                return False
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Test {i} raised unexpected exception: {e} for input {repr(text)}")
            return False

    # Error cases
    error_cases = [
        ('"ab"c,d', ","),
        ('"ab', ","),
    ]
    for i, (text, delim) in enumerate(error_cases):
        try:
            parse_csv(text, delim)
            print(f"Error test {i} failed: Expected ValueError for {repr(text)}")
            return False
        except ValueError:
            pass
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error test {i} raised unexpected exception {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
            return False

    print("All tests passed!")
    return True

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_parse_csv()
